newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan invites bids for oil exploration.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan invites bids for oil exploration.

text.p: Pakistan's Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Resources invited bids on Friday for petroleum exploration rights in 23 blocks around the country.
Bids should be submitted by July 21 and successful applicants will be notified by July 28, it said in a statement.

On offer are five blocks in the central province of Punjab, eight in the southern province of Sindh, one in North West Frontier Province, four in the southwestern province of Balochistan province and five offshore in the Indus river.
